intro: Every release of this directory, newest first. Small, hand-made changes to a small place.

entries.title: Featured slots, shareable cards and a quiz
changes: Featured launch slots: mark a listing "featured": true in config/sites.json and it takes a slot on the home page and the launch feed.
Every listing can be shared as a launch card — copy the link, share it, or download a PNG drawn in the browser.
A new game: the Website Personality Quiz. Six questions, five archetypes, four site recommendations.
Listings are checked before they ship — duplicate, broken, spammy and incomplete entries fail a GitHub Action.

entries.title: A launch feed, and collections you keep
changes: /new-websites is a real launch feed now: sort by newest, recently updated or most discussed, filter by category, tag and free versus paid, and a launch of the day.
Visitors can build collections such as “Useful AI tools” or “Sites to revisit”, keep them private or share them by link, and follow other curators.
The Games tab in the header got a tidier button, with a chevron that lines up with the word.
The admin review queue can approve a submission and publish it straight into config/sites.json through the GitHub API.

entries.title: Playful type and a tidier account
changes: Nunito and Baloo 2 replace the old Futura stack, so the whole site reads rounder and friendlier.
The account menu marks log out in red and keeps each option apart with a faint rule.
Account pages put the three tabs in a row on phones, and move the menu to the right on desktop.
This changelog page itself, with the version number in the footer.

entries.title: A new home at benlaunches.icu
changes: The directory moved to www.benlaunches.icu and the header now reads Ben Launches.
Shared deep links work again — /advertise, /submit and friends no longer show a missing page.
Advertise prices now run from $1 to $10 depending on the placement or service.
Articles moved under Libraries in the menu, and search no longer shows how many sites are listed.

entries.title: Accounts and profiles
changes: Public profiles and a person search, so you can see who saved what.
Accounts moved to Supabase, so saved sites and votes follow you between devices.

entries.title: Games, badges and the small print
changes: This or That became a phone-first verdict bar.
The featured-on strip picked up a StartupTrusted badge.
Terms, privacy and problem reports landed, along with the weekly blog workflow.
